name: Twilight Vale
summary: In Twilight Vale, beasts and furbolgs prowl the dark woods between Darkshore and Ashenvale. The southern forest is a perilous threshold between Darkshore’s tainted coast and Ashenvale’s sacred canopies.

sections.title: A Perilous Threshold
sections.body: Twilight Vale stretches from south of Ameth'Aran to the Ashenvale border, where dusk holds over Darkshore’s southern woods. Corruption has reached deep into the wildlife. Rabid bears roam beside feral nightsabers, while hostile furbolg tribes stalk the trees. Sentinels and travelers advise you to keep to the main road. Even a few paces into the woods can bring a swift, deadly ambush.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight Vale located?
faq.answer: Twilight Vale lies in southern Darkshore, beginning just south of the highborne ruins of Ameth'Aran and reaching the pass into Ashenvale.
Rabid bears, aggressive nightsabers, and corrupted furbolgs wander the vale and attack those who enter their territory.

faq.q: Is it safe to travel through the vale?
faq.answer: The main dirt road is far safer than the underbrush. If you stray from it, feral beasts may cross your path.

faq.q: Why is the wildlife in the vale corrupted?
aliases: why are bears rabid in darkshore
faq.answer: Darkshore has suffered since the Third War, and sundering magic lingers across northern Kalimdor. Tainted water and dark magical residue have maddened wildlife and made peaceful furbolgs violent.

angles.text: As a night elf, you mourn the corruption of the southern woods’ native beasts and the fall of furbolg neighbors near Ashenvale’s threshold.
As a druid traveling between Darkshore and Ashenvale, you see the sickness afflicting the vale’s creatures and the urgent need to cleanse the land.
